shared_elements: simplified linear rendering of body parts
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic anthropomorphic imagery combined with simple circular/disc and curved motifs, but that is about as generic as shared iconography gets. A shows a flat multi-figure scene of small stick-like humans with raised arms, boats and weapons distributed across a rock face, while B is a single monumental frontal head-and-torso figure whose body carries isolated symbolic devices (rings, arcs, hanging forms) arranged around its own anatomy — a completely different compositional idea and figural convention.
